name: import-leads
description: Takes a lead list from wherever it lives and lands it in the CRM config names, HubSpot or Salesforce, correctly: mapped, deduped, matched to companies, on the memberships the org's grid names (status lists on HubSpot, native member statuses on Salesforce), verified by reading every write back, and written back to a Notion source. Every write sits behind one confirmation, nothing is invented to complete a row, and nobody is guessed. The first job plugin: it owns no database, reads no foundation config, and keeps a private config of its own that nothing else reads or writes.
